purpose: Document first-party local registry evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-service review.
assessment: Delta State's official pages establish a Ministry of Lands and Surveys workflow in Asaba and list an Asaba Area Planning Office. The reviewed first-party pages and linked PDFs provide administrative procedure and custodian evidence only. No public JavaScript viewer, configuration, WMS/WFS/REST endpoint, parcel schema, CRS declaration, or anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was exposed. This is not evidence of citywide absence.
